channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: NCHSAA Basketball Glance, Jan. 26, 2026
item.description: Unbeaten Farmville Central and state-ranked teams like Kinston, Northern Nash, Rocky Mount and Wilson Prep headline NCHSAA Big East, Eastern Plains, ECAC and Three Rivers basketball standings and Friday scores.

item.title: Barton had banner year, raising $15.4M
item.description: Barton College posted a record $15.4M fundraising year, fueling major health sciences facility upgrades and boosting its endowment to support student scholarships.

item.title: Free tax preparation assistance begins in new location
item.description: Free IRS Volunteer Income Tax Assistance is available in Wilson for simple returns under about $150,000 income, by appointment at GigEast.

item.title: Small Business Center briefs: Webinars, seminars offered in February
item.description: Wilson Community College’s Small Business Center offers free February webinars and seminars on shipping, marketing, AI tools, podcasts, legal basics and business naming for entrepreneurs.

item.title: Donald Trump’s Board of Peace — or piece of the action
item.description: Trump’s new Gaza “Board of Peace” charter grants him sweeping control as chairman, from choosing members to interpreting rules and naming his successor, prompting criticism as a personal power-and-profit vehicle.

item.title: Religious rights can’t be silenced by activist agendas
item.description: After anti-ICE activists disrupted a Minnesota church service, Donna King argues that the First Amendment doesn't excuse intimidation in houses of worship and warns such tactics threaten religious liberty.

item.title: Cooper’s fundraising bonanza
item.description: Roy Cooper’s record-breaking $9.5M fundraising haul signals strong momentum in North Carolina’s Senate race, dwarfing Michael Whatley’s $5.1M and drawing major national Democratic support.

item.title: Reforming SNAP is a fiscal necessity
item.description: New federal SNAP rules could more than quadruple North Carolina’s costs, but a commentator argues they’re needed to cut errors, enforce work requirements and address large federal deficits.

item.title: Challengers drop appeals on Knight's candidacy for sheriff
item.description: Challenges to Bobby Knight’s bid for Wilson County sheriff have ended, as both opponents drop appeals, leaving his GOP primary candidacy intact after a party-affiliation dispute.
